column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
a dry run names the judge before saying what it would squash
a judge that differs from main's engine by one comment is not the engine main accepted
and FELIX_KERNEL is refused before the cache is even consulted
and a doctored judge merges nothing
and names the judge only after the merge is reported
and the dry run says the judge is byte-identical to main
and the merge names the entry main declares, not the harness inside it
and the refusal names the version main declares or the cache it searched
felix merge refuses a self-governed repository when FELIX_KERNEL is set
